metadata.description:
Did you know that although the French language comes from France, it is an official language in 26 countries around the world?!

Interested in learning this fascinating language? Here’s a great place to start! Join Sophie and David in this fun and interactive card as they teach you 100 commonly-used words in French… from bonjour to au revoir!
